== Summary ==
[[Chris Menzel]] (right, reading) presents [[Kevin Jaap]]'s Hall of Fame induction before the main event, with Kevin Jaap (white polo) and [[Tamás Papp]] (blue).

* '''Event:''' [[2024 World Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2024-09-21
* '''Camera date:''' 2024-09-21 (Day 1; posted that evening)
* '''Identification:''' [[Chris Menzel]]: his name and "Hall of Fame" are embroidered on his shirt, and the wrap-up says he presented Kevin Jaap's Hall of Fame award; [[Kevin Jaap]]: face match with his [[:File:Kevin Jaap 2024 Hall of Fame.jpg|Hall of Fame photo]], where he wears the same white polo; [[Tamás Papp]]: face match with his [[:File:Tamas Papp (community card).jpg|community card]], and he was the tournament director, here working the organizers' desk in the same blue T-shirt all day. The others are not named.

== Source ==
Posted in the #2024-worlds-bochum channel of the Players Committee Slack (starwarsccg.slack.com), 2024-09-21. Original file name: 1000006014.jpg (4032×2268); Slack file id F07N9GT07KQ.
* '''Photographer / posted by:''' [[Scott Lingrell]] (Slack: Scott)
